notes: Hashes were taken from the original Play-signed split set (base.apk, split_config.arm64_v8a.apk) of 0.7.64 / versionCode 193.
libil2cpp.so: every hook address and byte patch in work/mod/src is hard-coded for this exact file.
global-metadata.dat: the IL2CPP type/method metadata that the reviewed addresses and field offsets were derived from.
libunity.so: pinned fail-closed; the hooked IL2CPP code calls into the engine, so an engine change without a libil2cpp change is not assumed to be safe.
A different version is accepted only if all pinned entries are byte-identical; there is no automatic re-mapping.

required_splits: taken from the original split_UnityDataAssetPack.apk (scenes 1-3, their shared assets, the Addressables catalog). The game ships these only in that asset pack, so a set without the split, or a standalone APK, is rejected even if its native code matches.
